text: **dsh-collab-dev**（DSH 插件，web/desktop）：把一个开发目标整理成经审阅后再运行的协作计划。它通过 AgentTeams 原生团队接入 DSH，提供 `/collab-dev` 目标入口、完整任务依赖与并行范围校验、双 worker 实现、验证和独立审查流程，并可用 `/collab-status` 查看验证结果与交付阻塞。适合希望让 DSH 多个智能体分工完成开发并保留计划审阅和集成门禁的主会话用户。需要已配置的模型、兼容版本的 DSH 与 Node.js；计划保存在项目 `.collab-dev/` 目录。

**dsh-collab-dev** (DSH plugin): creates reviewable plans for native AgentTeams. It checks dependencies and parallel scopes, coordinates coding, verification, review and integration, and shows progress through `/collab-status`. Requires configured DSH and Node.js; plans go in `.collab-dev/`.
想让 DSH 把一个开发目标拆成可审阅的协作计划。
希望多个 DSH 智能体并行实现互不重叠的代码任务。
如何让主智能体先定接口，再分配实现、验证和审查？
我想在运行协作开发前先检查完整任务依赖。
需要在团队完成后查看验证结果和交付阻塞。
怎样避免两个并行开发任务同时修改同一片文件？
I want DSH agents to implement separate parts of a coding task in parallel.
Can I review a complete development plan before the team starts?
**dsh-collab-dev** 的功能「计划校验」：主智能体保存计划时检查任务类型、负责人、依赖图、阶段完整性和独立审查；循环、缺失依赖、并行写入范围冲突或缺少集成验收会被拒绝。
**dsh-collab-dev** 的功能「并行协作启动」：主智能体调用启动工具后创建待审批的 AgentTeams 团队，并逐项映射计划依赖；实现任务需声明工作区路径和验证命令。
**dsh-collab-dev** 的功能「协作命令入口」：用户运行 `/collab-dev <目标>` 后，主会话收到先制定架构、保存完整计划并创建团队草稿的请求；空目标或超过 4000 字符会返回用法错误。
**dsh-collab-dev** 的功能「进度与交付状态」：用户运行 `/collab-status` 或调用状态工具，可查看任务完成情况、验证和集成输出、成员进度以及交付阻塞和提示。
dsh-collab-dev 的团队使用共享工作区，bundle 未配置文件系统隔离；团队成员工具策略仅禁止其调用三个规划/状态工具。

dsh-collab-dev README · DSH 协作开发插件：[English](README.en.md) · [下载 v1.0.1](https://github.com/sxwer001/dsh-collab-dev/releases/tag/v1.0.1)

主智能体规划，子智能体并行开发，验证与独立审查通过后汇总交付。

dsh-collab-dev README · 安装：适用于 **DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 和 `0.2.1-rc.5`**，需要已配置的模型，以及 Node.js 22.19+（22.x）或 24+。内置 AgentTeams 0.1.28，保留需求快照绑定和不完整计划审批保护。

桌面版从插件管理安装 `.tgz`。网页版可用：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/sxwer001/dsh-collab-dev/releases/download/v1.0.1/dsh-collab-dev-1.0.1.tgz
```

安装后按宿主提示重启。本包已内置团队组件，同一 profile 请勿重复启用独立 AgentTeams bundle。

dsh-collab-dev README · 使用：```text
/collab-dev 为现有应用增加订单 API 和订单查询页面
```

1. 主智能体检查项目，建立共享框架、接口和完整任务计划。
2. 在团队面板审阅计划，点击 **Approve & Run**。
3. 两个 worker 并行开发，verifier 验证，reviewer 独立审查，最后集成。
4. 输入 `/collab-status` 查看进度、验证结果和交付阻塞。

计划和架构保存在 `.collab-dev/`。无效依赖、缺失验收阶段及并行写入范围冲突会被拒绝；上传不完整的计划无法批准运行。调整草稿任务数量时，请丢弃草稿并重新保存、创建计划。

dsh-collab-dev README · 范围：v1.0.1 使用 DSH 原生子智能体与共享工作区，按任务范围协作；不提供文件系统隔离、独立 worktree 或 Codex／Claude Code 后端。Windows 保存计划时，对临时文件锁导致的 EPERM/EBUSY 原子重命名失败作有限重试，持续失败仍报错并清理未发布计划。

验证使用 Windows、Node 24 和上述两个宿主，包含脚本模型的成功/失败门禁回归。2026-11-04，1.0.1 安装包在 rc.5 上通过 `opencode-go / deepseek-v4.1-flash` 真实模型验收：8 个任务全部完成，两个 worker 开发区间重叠 82.216 秒；独立复跑 30 个测试、smoke 和额外 46 项合同检查均通过。集成门禁曾发现主智能体写错溢出测试并阻止交付；主智能体修正后由 verifier 重新验收，失败过程保留在测试记录中。正式流程共 116 次模型请求，上游连接失败由宿主重试恢复。本机 DSH 可执行文件的重启恢复及 `/collab-status`「可交付」也通过。本轮真实模型覆盖限于该模型，旧版结果保留为历史证据。

dsh-collab-dev README · DSH Collaborative Development：[中文](README.md) · [Download v1.0.1](https://github.com/sxwer001/dsh-collab-dev/releases/tag/v1.0.1)

A main agent plans the work; native workers implement in parallel, followed by verification, independent review and integration.

dsh-collab-dev README · Install：Requires **DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` or `0.2.1-rc.5`**, a configured model and Node.js 22.19+ (22.x) or 24+. Includes AgentTeams 0.1.28 with the requirements snapshot and incomplete-plan approval fixes.

Install the `.tgz` through Desktop's plugin manager. For a web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/sxwer001/dsh-collab-dev/releases/download/v1.0.1/dsh-collab-dev-1.0.1.tgz
```
dsh-collab-dev README · Install：Restart when requested by the host. The package includes its team component; do not enable the standalone AgentTeams bundle in the same profile.

dsh-collab-dev README · Use：1. Run `/collab-dev <goal>`. The main agent prepares shared scaffolding, interfaces and the complete plan.
2. Review the plan in the native team panel, then choose **Approve & Run**.
3. Two workers implement independent scopes, a verifier runs checks, and a reviewer reviews the results before integration.
4. Run `/collab-status` for progress, verification results and delivery blockers.

dsh-collab-dev README · Use：Plans and architecture are saved in `.collab-dev/`. Invalid dependencies, missing acceptance stages and overlapping parallel scopes are rejected. Incomplete uploads cannot be approved. To change the number of draft tasks, discard the draft and save/start a new plan.

dsh-collab-dev README · Scope：Version 1.0.1 uses native DSH agents in a shared workspace with scope audits. It provides no filesystem isolation, separate worktrees or external Codex/Claude Code backend. Transient Windows EPERM/EBUSY rename failures receive bounded retries; persistent failures remain visible and unpublished plans are cleaned up.

dsh-collab-dev README · Scope：Verification uses Windows, Node 24 and both hosts above, including scripted success/failure gate regressions. On 2026-11-04, the 1.0.1 package passed real-model acceptance on rc.5 with `opencode-go / deepseek-v4.1-flash`: eight completed tasks, 82.216 seconds of overlapping worker execution, 30 passing tests, smoke and 46 independent contract checks. Integration correctly blocked an incorrect captain-authored overflow test; the captain fixed it and the verifier reran acceptance. The original failure remains in the test evidence. The workflow made 116 model requests, recovering upstream connection failures through native retries. Restart through the installed DSH executable and a deliverable `/collab-status` also passed. Live acceptance covers this model only; earlier release results remain historical evidence.
